paper_metadata.title: The influence of Mo and Nb on liquid phase sintering and mechanical properties of W-Ni-Fe-Co based tungsten heavy alloy

evidence.quote: The influence of Mo and Nb on liquid phase sintering and mechanical properties of W-Ni-Fe-Co based tungsten heavy alloy
The nomenclature of the alloys is based on the concentration of the alloying elements. Therefore, the base composition alloy is here after mentioned as WNFC
Elemental powders as per compositions were carefully weighed and hand mixed for 20 min in a mortar pestle.
There after the powders were blended using a turbo mixer (Make: Alphie) for 60 min at a speed of 80 RPM without any mixing medium.
Compaction was carried out using a uniaxial press at a 350 MPa compaction pressure for a duration of 1 min.
